---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
---

## Description

A clear and concise description of the feature or enhancement.

## Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the workflow it would improve.

## Agent/Component Affected

Which agent or component would this feature apply to (e.g., `precision_biomarker_agent`, `rag-chat-pipeline`, `lib/hcls_common`)?

## Clinical Impact (if applicable)

Describe any clinical relevance, such as improved diagnostic accuracy, new therapeutic area coverage, or faster time-to-result.
